title: Open restriction comparison of residue homology sheaves
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an open subscheme and x a point of U. Supply derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category] on S, all over-sites and all residue schemes. Exact derived over-site restriction followed by the derived over-equivalence, derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] to x, and degree-zero homology is naturally isomorphic to derived pullback from S to U.ι(x), degree-zero homology, and ordinary tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] along Spec of the open immersion residue-field map [def-weil-residue-field]. The categories on U and its residue scheme use their standard localizations, independently of the supplied localization universe. No global-sections functor is applied in this statement.

proof.text: Combine the two exact derived restriction functors using mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. The over-site equivalence and restrictFunctorIsoPullback identify their underived composite with tensor pullback along U.ι, by uniqueness of left adjoints. This functor is exact. Its mapDerivedCategory is its left derived functor by isLeftDerivedFunctor_of_inverts and leftDerivedUnique. Thus, for standard localizations, derived restriction is derived open pullback.

Transport the source of the exact restriction functor from the supplied localization to the standard localization. Lift the comparison of mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh and Localization.compUniqFunctor through the fully faithful precomposition with Qh. For derived pullback, extract the left-derived counits from exists_derivedPullback and identify the underlying tensor pullbacks using their specified object and morphism equalities. Transport their right Kan extensions across the domain and codomain localization equivalences; uniqueness of right Kan extensions gives the comparison. Similarly lift homologyFunctorFactorsh to compare homology in the two localizations.

For standard localizations, apply the derived composition comparison twice to the commuting residue square given by Scheme.Hom.SpecMap_residueFieldMap_fromSpecResidueField. This identifies restriction followed by pullback to x with pullback to U.ι(x) followed by derived pullback along Spec of the residue-field map.

The open immersion residue-field map is an isomorphism, hence so is its spectrum map. Tensor pullback along a scheme isomorphism is an equivalence, using its identity and composition comparisons. It is therefore exact, so leftDerivedUnique identifies its derived pullback with mapDerivedCategory. Apply mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso to commute it with homology. Whisker and compose these isomorphisms with the preceding localization transports to obtain the desired natural isomorphism.

theorem nonempty_localizedResidueHomology_sheaf_restriction_iso (S : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ s : S, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField s)).toRingedSpace))]
    (U : S.Opens) (x : U.toScheme) :
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} U.toScheme.Modules :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (SheafOfModules.{u}
        (moduleRings (Spec (U.toScheme.residueField x)).toRingedSpace)) :=
      HasDerivedCategory.standard _
    letI : (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.Additive :=
      Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _
    Nonempty
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
          (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.mapDerivedCategory.{w, u + 1} ⋙
        derivedPullback.{u, u + 1} (U.toScheme.fromSpecResidueField x) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u}
            (moduleRings (Spec (U.toScheme.residueField x)).toRingedSpace)) 0 ≅
      derivedPullback (S.fromSpecResidueField (U.ι x)) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u}
            (moduleRings (Spec (S.residueField (U.ι x))).toRingedSpace)) 0 ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (Spec.map (U.ι.residueFieldMap x)))
